text: Raw milk from silage-free cows, a spontaneous whey starter and no additives make this the strictest of the grana cheeses. At least 12 months of ripening gives the finely granular paste that splits into flakes.

steps.note: The curd is cooked in copper.
The curd is put into moulds that mark its origin, 35–45 cm across, for a cheese of at least 30 kg.
The cheese is put into saturated brine, with as much salt dissolved as it will hold.
The cheese is kept at 16 °C or warmer in summer.
